title: Gandora on Shining Sarcophagus
summary: The Gandora dragons with the Shining Sarcophagus engine the page builds them on, plus staples and an automatic Extra Deck. Gandora-G the Dragon of Destruction, the newest (2024), summons itself from the hand while you control Shining Sarcophagus. It then pays half your LP to destroy and banish every other card on the field, summons a Level 7 or lower Sarcophagus monster from the Deck, and grows 300 ATK per banished card. Shining Sarcophagus searches a card that mentions it each turn. Dark Magician Girl the Magician's Apprentice and Gadget Trio search the Sarcophagus or its Spells/Traps. Archfiend's Advent and the Silent Zeros are what Gandora-G calls from the Deck. The original Gandora and Gandora-X wipe the field the old way. Gigarays Gandora isn't released in the TCG.
main: Gandora-G the Dragon of Destruction
Newest: summons itself with the Sarcophagus; wipes and banishes, then calls a Sarcophagus monster.
Gandora the Dragon of Destruction
Pays half your LP to destroy and banish every other card.
Gandora-X the Dragon of Demolition
Destroys every other monster and burns for the biggest.
Dark Magician Girl the Magician's Apprentice
Summons itself by discarding and searches Shining Sarcophagus.
Gadget Trio
Searches Shining Sarcophagus or a Spell/Trap that mentions it.
Silent Magician Zero
Negates a Spell while you control the Sarcophagus.
Silent Swordsman Zero
Negates targeting of the Sarcophagus and its monsters.
Archfiend's Advent
Normal Summons free with the Sarcophagus; steals a monster.
Shining Sarcophagus
Continuous Spell: searches a card that mentions it every turn.
Future Silence
Searches a Sarcophagus monster; refills hands in battle.
Ties That Bind
Summons two small Sarcophagus monsters from the hand or Deck.
Turn Silence
Raises a Level and negates a monster effect.
Stronghold the Hidden Fortress
Trap Monster that grows with each Sarcophagus card.
